note: Cass County Conservation park (105 acres) just south of Lewis. The campground is up the hill in the woods south of the no-wake lake, past the conservation office and the DNR fisheries station; swimming area, boat ramp, and a trail to the rock cuts of the Nishnabotna River. Loop sites fit a 23-ft rig. The lake was drawn down and renovated in August 2025 and is refilling; the county expects good fishing again by 2028. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 46 sites (26 electric, 20 primitive), $15 electric ($10 non-electric), showers and dump, self-register first-come, open Apr 1 - Oct 31. Lake measured 6.3 ha (~16 acres, a lake not a pond). Waterfront lead: lakeview looks unearned (campground ~200-250 m south of the lake in dense woods); pin ~410 m off, in a farm field east of Lewis Rd.
flags: WATERFRONT (downgrade lead): stored lakeview -> not waterfront. The campground loops and campers are in continuous woods 'up the hill' south of 6.3-ha Cold Springs Lake (OSM way 1302986357); its south shore is ~200-250 m north of the loops through dense trees, with the conservation office lot between. No official site photos or map exist to show a view. The stored lakeview evidence was read at the stored pin, which is in a farm field east of Lewis Rd, so it is not evidence.

PIN (~410 m off): stored 41.29050,-95.08300 is in the crop field east of Lewis Rd. The campground loops (visible on NAIP with campers, and on Esri as loop roads under canopy) centre near 41.2888,-95.0874. Proposed 41.28883,-95.08742.
